status: shadow-only: not read by the native runtime; baseline.json remains the active B36 policy
score: per image: minimum over person crops of the mean CCIP distance to the three nearest positive-gallery images (s36_scoring.knn); smaller is better
rules: Automatic membership only when the image score is <= automatic_max_knn3 and at least automatic_min_prior_manual_rejections manual rejections existed library-wide before the decision (cold-start guard).
Images scoring above automatic_max_knn3 and <= recommendation_max_knn3 are recommendations only, never automatic memberships.

calibration.method: replay_eval.py evaluate --space s36 --scorers knn3 rule6 contrast --witness references --feedback-lag 1 --rates 0.005 0.01 0.015 0.02 0.03 0.05
calibration.selection: automatic = final walk-forward threshold for target FPR 2%; recommendation = target FPR 5%
calibration.cold_start_note: Including 2026-09-09 the observed walk-forward FPR never falls below 2.5%: the first threshold came from 25 rejections and one character took 16-17 false positives. The rejection-count guard addresses this.
limitations: Historical replay of selected labels, not prospective validation.
Only about 17 manual rejections exist after 2026-09-13, so recent drift is weakly measured.
1,104 earlier automatic acceptances were never manually reviewed and are not labels.
